candidates.title: Woman flagged by ID scanner as nationwide 'public safety concern' after incident in Winnipeg bar
candidates.description: Privacy experts are raising concerns after a Winnipeg bar flagged a woman as a nationwide public safety concern through its ID scanning system, which led to her being denied entry to a Calgary Stampede venue in July.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Yellowknife woman diagnosed with ALS in Alberta after spending thousands to leave territory for specialist treatment
candidates.description: Mary Rose Blackduck was diagnosed with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), a rare nervous system disease that leads to damaged muscles. The typical life expectancy after diagnosis is two to five years.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: A tale of two harvests: Rain delivers rebound for some Alberta farmers, disaster for others
candidates.description: As harvest approaches in Central Alberta, summer rains have positioned some farmers for strong yields while proving catastrophic for others.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: N.L. man accused of killing 6-year-old boy in impaired driving crash was fugitive, involved in crash 2 days earlier
candidates.description: The man accused of killing a six-year-old boy while driving impaired in St. John’s last month was involved in a separate crash two days earlier, CBC News has learned. While he was wanted on an outstanding warrant, police did not make an arrest at the scene.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: It's election season in Quebec. Let’s get you up to speed
candidates.description: All signs point to the provincial election campaign officially kicking off this week. Here’s a breakdown of what’s at stake, what you should know about the main party leaders and some key issues that could surface during the campaign.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Food-conditioned bear killed in Fort Nelson, B.C., as resident launches community safety petition
candidates.description: The B.C. Conservation Officer Service says a black bear in Fort Nelson, B.C., was killed on Aug. 19 after several reports of the bear going door-to-door knocking over garbage bins.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 'The whole island is heaven': U.S. couple considering parting ways with isle off Cape Breton’s coast
candidates.description: William F. Baker and his wife have owned Henry Island for the past 35 years, but now at 84 years old he is considering selling the nearly 90-hectare island that is only reachable by boat.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Documents reveal Ambassador Bridge owner's private meeting with Ottawa ahead of Gordie Howe opening
candidates.description: Ambassador Bridge owner Matthew Moroun sought a meeting with senior Canadian officials as the bridge's nearly century-old monopoly on commercial traffic between Windsor and Detroit faced a new competitor. Government records reveal why Ottawa agreed to listen, but much of what Moroun wanted remains secret.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Partial lunar eclipse to grace Canadian skies this week
candidates.description: On the night of Aug. 27-28, a partial lunar eclipse will be visible across the country. Here's when to see it.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: More grizzly bears killed in 2024 than any other year on record in Alberta
candidates.description: Data from the Alberta government indicates 40 grizzlies were killed by people in 2024, with 21 of those bears killed by law enforcement. Those are the highest grizzly bear mortality numbers of any year on record, and the only year in which more than half of the total deaths were carried out by law enforcement.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Rare thunderstorm with lightning strikes wows southern B.C., causing havoc at Vancouver airport
candidates.description: A preliminary count from Environment Canada reported more than 1,800 incidences of lightning over the Lower Mainland on Saturday night and Sunday morning, while the B.C. Wildfire Service said it recorded more than 7,000 strikes provincewide.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Suspect in Fort Smith, N.W.T., shooting arrested
candidates.description: The RCMP have arrested a person suspected of a shooting on Saturday morning that injured three people and prompted a community-wide lockdown of more than 13 hours.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 'Effectively, we're out of business': U.S. tariffs cut Manitoba honey farm off from vast majority of customers
candidates.description: Osee Podolsky, general manager at Podolski Honey Farms, says the vast majority of honey produced at the family-run business in Ethelbert, Man., is shipped to customers across the United States.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Why are there suddenly so many data centres planned in Canada? Your questions answered
candidates.description: The sudden spike in AI data centres that are planned or under construction in Canada is sparking controversy among those hesitant to have the massive buildings that power this technology humming away in their backyards. We answered some of your questions here.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Ontario businesses brace for tariffs after U.S.-Canada trade talks collapse
candidates.description: Some businesses in Ontario are bracing for tarrifs but pledging steadfastness after Canadian and U.S. trade negotiators came close, but ultimately failed at the 11th hour to reach a trade agreement Friday night.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: U.K. to provide long-range missile blueprints to Ukraine
candidates.description: European leaders joined President Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Kyiv on Monday for official celebrations marking Ukraine's Independence Day as Russia pushes on with its invasion of the country.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: WNBA star Natasha Cloud confronts Enes Kanter Freedom over anti-trans shirt at Fever-Sky game
candidates.description: Former NBA centre Enes Kanter Freedom was ejected from Sunday night’s Indiana-Chicago WNBA game after he was confronted by Sky guard Natasha Cloud late in the third quarter.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Trump says Canada 'wants the benefits' of being a U.S. state 'without being one' as trade dispute deepens
candidates.description: In his first comments since trade talks broke down, President Donald Trump said Canada "wants the benefits" of being a U.S. state "without being one." The president's brief post on his Truth Social platform early Sunday comes after new 50 per cent U.S. tariffs on a range of Canadian goods took effect.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Fast-moving wildfire threatens Reno, Nevada, forcing thousands to evacuate
candidates.description: A fast-moving wildfire that jumped over fire trucks and made it difficult for crews to reach hot spots destroyed homes in northwest Reno, Nevada, on Sunday. Shifting winds challenged firefighters trying to bring it under control, and authorities urged some 90,000 people to evacuate.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Zelenskyy says holding elections during war would 'destroy' Ukraine
candidates.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says holding elections as active fighting with Russia continues would "split Ukraine." His warning comes after ousted former Ukrainian Defence Minister Mykhailo Fedorov last week called for a wartime vote.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: How will the British press cover Harry and Meghan this time around?
candidates.description: Many questions have already been asked about the couple's return — but after being away for years following a tumultuous relationship with the British press that appeared to have been a factor in their decamping to California, could the tabloids' fascination about the couple peter out this time?
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Canadian business leaders brace for lost deals after trade talks crumble, 50% U.S. tariffs take effect
candidates.description: Canadian businesses and industry leaders are bracing for the full effects of fresh 50 per cent U.S. tariffs, crossing their fingers that domestic support will come quickly, after trade talks between the two countries fell apart.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Canada's an agricultural superpower. Could it feed the whole world?
candidates.description: Experts say that red tape, infrastructure bottlenecks and labour shortages are among the factors undermining Canada's ability to send more food around the world, while competing countries continue to scale up their exports.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Iran faces 'greatest financial offensive ever', says US treasury secretary
candidates.description: Scott Bessent says the US will sever all economic ties with the country and that any nation partnering with Iran financially will also be isolated.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Russia's second-biggest online retailer targeted in Ukrainian strikes
candidates.description: Ozon says its warehouses across southern Russia, including in Dagestan and Krasnodar, were hit in the overnight strikes.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Israel warns of 'forceful' response to kites flown from Gaza
candidates.description: Hamas says the kites found in Israeli border communities in recent days were launched by children in Gaza.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Sonya Massey's killer Sean Grayson dies in US prison
candidates.description: The former police officer, whose crime reignited the debate about US police brutality, was undergoing treatment for cancer.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Guinea rubbish landfill collapse kills 31
candidates.description: A mound of rubbish at a major waste site buried several homes in the capital, the government says.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Four arrested over boxing champion's murder in South Africa
candidates.description: One of the suspects is due in court on Monday to be charged with murder and attempted murder.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Maradona's 'Hand of God' ball sells for £2.5m

candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Trump says Canada wants 'benefits' of being US state after trade talks collapse
candidates.description: Canada's PM said he was "reluctantly" announcing retaliatory tariffs and accused the US of starting a trade war.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: The formidable challenges facing new Tata boss
candidates.description: Corporate India's most coveted top job is open. But finding a new leader for Tata Sons is no easy task.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: 'Scared to death': Thousands evacuate Nevada homes as wildfire spreads
candidates.description: Tens of thousands of people in the US state have been warned to evacuate as the wildfire spreads in the outskirts of Reno.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: What do locals think of IndyCar in Washington DC?
candidates.description: US President Donald Trump was among hundreds of people who gathered to see the race through Washington DC streets on Sunday.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Trump Mobile promoted a 'Made in the USA' phone - but the details kept changing

candidates.title: Sharing dangerous driving videos is 'truly reprehensible', PM says
candidates.description: His comments come as the government urged TikTok and other social media firms to remove wrong-way driving videos.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: World's oceans hit highest temperature on record as El Niño grows
candidates.description: The record "is another clear signal of an ocean under growing stress", according to Dr Samantha Burgess from the European Copernicus climate change service.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: France links sharp rise in drownings to heatwaves
candidates.description: A government minister says people have been taking risks by going into the water, with 301 deaths since 19 June.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is set to unveil new economic sanctions on Iran
candidates.description: The Trump administration calls this "economic D-Day" on Iran. Iran vows to respond to fresh sanctions in a "seismic manner."
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: U.S. to detail new economic pressures on Iran. And, Canada to impose tariffs on U.S.
candidates.description: Today, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is set to announce details on new economic pressures on Iran. And, Canada has vowed to impose retaliatory tariffs against the U.S.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Learning to live in a post-American world
candidates.description: In a recent article for Foregin Affairs , Mark Leonard makes that argument that America's leading role in the world order is fading. He discusses his argument with NPR's Danielle Kurtzleben.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Chinese company flexes dominance in robotics space with splashy stock market debut
candidates.description: The Chinese robotics company Unitree, known for its highly advanced humanoid robots, made a tremendous debut on Shanghai's stock market. The company is considered an industry leader in robotics.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: The U.S. & Canada are fighting over tariffs. How is that affecting small businesses?
candidates.description: NPR's Danielle Kurtzleben speaks with Mike Roach and Kim Osgood, owners of Paloma Clothing in Portland, Ore., about how the tariff fight between the U.S. and Canada is affecting their business.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: High-intensity sprints can trigger molecular changes in the bloodstream
candidates.description: A new study finds that an all-out sprint may have unique benefits when it comes to the proteins and tiny molecules in your bloodstream.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Nonprofits are helping musicians pay for insurance in Austin, Texas, and beyond
candidates.description: A nonprofit and a local public health agency are subsidizing marketplace health insurance for Austin musicians , even as rising healthcare costs make the program more expensive.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Becerra, running for governor of California, faces a health insurance problem
candidates.description: The nation's uninsured rate hit a historical low when Xavier Becerra was health secretary. Now he wants to be California's next governor as Trump's actions have driven people off health insurance.
candidates.author: NPR
